Absolute must try
Oct 2024 • Friends
My friends and I had been traveling around Vietnam and wanted dimsum. Being from Vancouver, Canada, we all agreed this restaurant’s dimsum was one of the best we’ve had. The quality of the ingredients and flavor was very traditional. We especially loved their egg tart (flakey crust) and their Shanghai dumplings (thin-skinned and juicy)! We liked the egg tart so much that my friend wanted to buy some home. The restaurant is clean and provides a nice Chinese ambience. Definitely Michelin worthy! Would absolutely come back again!

Excellent Chinese restaurant
Jan 2024 • Couples
We dined at Dim Tu Tác in District 2 last night. 

Not having reservations we had to wait approximately 20 minutes for a table.

The Cantonese menu is very large and all inclusive.

I enjoyed the seafood, hot and sour soup, half of a Peking duck (served on “crepes”) and a hot soup for dessert. All were cooked well and were very tasty. 

The duck was placed on the crepes in a different manner than I have experienced in the United States. We were also presented with a plate full with the balance of the duck. 

Service was attentive without being overbearing. Prices were reasonable.

Disappointing and Overpriced
Jul 2023 • Friends
Maybe it's just that my perception of what Dim Sum should be is distorted somewhat as an American but if you advertise yourself to be a Dim Sum restaurant, you should be offering it as part of dinner!

I arrived at the restaurant at about 8:30PM and was disappointed to find out that not only was there no dim sum being offered but there weren't even any dim sum offerings (traditional dumplings, spring rolls, noodles, etc.) that were available to order or on the menu!
 
In terms of the dishes that we actually ordered, it was a mixed bag. The deep-fried prawns in honey sauce were very flavorful and fresh and far and away the best plate we got. The charcoal wagyu beef was solid but definitely not worthy of a $480,000 VND price tag. I personally found both the deepfried cuttlefish cake with black truffle and omelette with scallop dishes to be uninspiring.

At the end of the day, 4 dishes and a meal for 2 cost over $2M VND - just not worth it when you can find better options for a quarter of the price.

Bad parking staff service
Feb 2021 • Friends
We had really bad experience on parking staff sefvice on Feb 15 2021. We went there at 4:30 pm for dimsum but the staff there said they stopped serving dimsum at that time & asked us to visit another branch at Takashimaya mall (about 10 minutes walking). That staff said we could leave our bikes there & walk to another branch for eating. But the parking staff said NO & asked us to pay 10.000vnd/ bike. The problem is we didn't use their service at all. All the time for getting in & out was about 2 minutes then we were paid 20.000 for the parking fees. It's unfair at all. This was the first time we had to pay for something we hadn't used at all. The first time & last time forever. Bad parking service at all!!!

Good but not good enough
Jun 2019 • Couples
This is probably the best of a Chinese restaurant that we have come across in the whole of Vietnam, in three decades. I would have labelled it Good, but that wasn't one such label between Average and Very Good.

 DTT has room to get up to be Very Good, if only it pays more attention to the service element. That was where it had visibly fallen short; much like many of other hospitality establishments in a developing country.

All said, food quality and presentation deserve mention. For this reason, we were there twice in two days; the second time, we brought two guests. And, the bill was fair and palatable.
